item.title: Batavia-based Henry H. Cook Plumbing, Heating, Electrical closes
item.description: After three decades of taking care of the plumbing, heating, and electrical needs of residents and businesses in Genesee County, Henry H. Cook has closed, owner Tammy Cook announced on Wednesday.Cook declined to comment further on the decision to close.
